evals.prompt: Which pages on our site should link to https://example.com/pricing?
evals.expected_output: Should run seo_internal_links with the URL on the local server, or `seo internal-links --url https://example.com/pricing` in the CLI. Should present the candidate pages and why they relate. Should note that this runs only on the person's machine.
assertions: Runs seo_internal_links or `seo internal-links` with the URL
Notes the command runs only locally

evals.prompt: Add the internal links to all the candidate pages for me.
evals.expected_output: Should show the candidates and the suggested anchor context first, and ask the person to approve specific changes before editing any page. Should not promise ranking gains from internal links.
assertions: Asks for approval before editing pages

evals.prompt: The internal-links result only has three candidates, so our internal linking is done.
evals.expected_output: Should not call internal linking complete. Should explain that the candidates come from Search Console queries and live page checks with limits, so pages outside them are not covered. Should present the three as a starting point.
assertions: Does not call internal linking complete
Explains the candidate list has limits
Presents the candidates as a starting point
